restore_policy.source: User-selected local File read via File.text in the browser; no upload endpoint or network write.
restore_policy.format: Schema 1 human imagery review observations, at most 2 MB / 5000 entries.
restore_policy.validation: Validate the whole file first, including canonical eight-field identities, allowed decisions, note type/2000-character limit and nullable/parseable reviewed timestamps. Duplicate identities reject the entire file.
restore_policy.matching: Only complete-preview comparisons in the current report; unmatched identities including refreshed generation timestamps are counted and skipped.
restore_policy.non_overwrite: Only entries with decision unreviewed, empty note and null reviewed_at can be filled. Existing choices, drafts and deliberate resets remain untouched. Empty incoming defaults are skipped.
restore_policy.persistence: Keep the original reviewed_at values. Browser storage failures retain exportable in-memory state with a visible warning.
restore_policy.science: No detector status, source record, frozen label, science key or image changes.

scope.test_data: Synthetic QA only. No private review export, notes, timestamps, receipt or summary is included in this evidence.
